sets.title: Report builder clones with skeleton pattern
sets.description: Three report builder classes that follow the same algorithm skeleton: validateInputs -> fetchData -> applyFilters -> formatOutput -> sendDelivery. Each step varies by implementation but the overall flow is identical. CAN be unified via Template Method pattern with abstract base class.

intended_refactoring.template_method: generate - final method defining algorithm skeleton

sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Reporting\Template;

abstract class ReportBuilder
{
    /**
     * Template method - final to enforce algorithm skeleton.
     * Defines the不变 algorithm structure with hook extension points.
     */
    final public function generate(ReportRequest $request): ReportResult
    {
        $this->logReport('Starting report generation');
        $this->validateInputs($request);
        $data = $this->fetchData($request);
        $filtered = $this->applyFilters($data, $request->getFilters());
        $formatted = $this->formatOutput($filtered);
        $this->sendDelivery($formatted, $request->getRecipient());
        $this->logReport('Report generation completed');
        return new ReportResult($formatted, true);
    }

    /**
     * Hook method - override for custom logging behavior.
     * Default implementation does nothing.
     */
    protected function logReport(string $message): void
    {
        // Default: no-op. Override for custom logging.
    }

    /**
     * Abstract method - MUST be implemented by subclasses.
     */
    abstract protected function validateInputs(ReportRequest $request): void;

    /**
     * Abstract method - MUST be implemented by subclasses.
     */
    abstract protected function fetchData(ReportRequest $request): array;

    /**
     * Abstract method - MUST be implemented by subclasses.
     */
    abstract protected function applyFilters(array $data, array $filters): array;

    /**
     * Abstract method - MUST be implemented by subclasses.
     */
    abstract protected function formatOutput(array $data): string;

    /**
     * Hook method - override for custom delivery behavior.
     * Default sends email.
     */
    protected function sendDelivery(string $content, string $recipient): void
    {
        mail($recipient, 'Report', $content);
    }
}

class SalesReportBuilder extends ReportBuilder
{
    protected function validateInputs(ReportRequest $request): void
    {
        if ($request->getStartDate() === null) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Start date required for sales report');
        }
    }

    protected function fetchData(ReportRequest $request): array
    {
        // Fetch sales data from database
        return [['product' => 'Widget', 'amount' => 100]];
    }

    protected function applyFilters(array $data, array $filters): array
    {
        return array_filter($data, fn($row) => $row['amount'] > ($filters['min_amount'] ?? 0));
    }

    protected function formatOutput(array $data): string
    {
        $output = "Sales Report\n";
        foreach ($data as $row) {
            $output .= sprintf("%s: $%d\n", $row['product'], $row['amount']);
        }
        return $output;
    }
}

class InventoryReportBuilder extends ReportBuilder
{
    protected function validateInputs(ReportRequest $request): void
    {
        if (empty($request->getWarehouseId())) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Warehouse ID required');
        }
    }

    protected function fetchData(ReportRequest $request): array
    {
        return [['item' => 'Box', 'quantity' => 50]];
    }

    protected function applyFilters(array $data, array $filters): array
    {
        return array_filter($data, fn($row) => $row['quantity'] < ($filters['max_quantity'] ?? PHP_INT_MAX));
    }

    protected function formatOutput(array $data): string
    {
        $output = "Inventory Report\n";
        foreach ($data as $row) {
            $output .= sprintf("%s: %d units\n", $row['item'], $row['quantity']);
        }
        return $output;
    }
}
